name: Tanabe Meito
source:
The man fated to journey through the ruined world in the year 2052. He appears as a result of his future counterpart (aka Berserker) regaining his sanity and his MYTH counterpart creating an accurate Tokyo in the year 2002 (according to Valkyrie). 

He reunites with his former lover Hiiro in 2016 Tokyo.
translation:
The man fated to journey through the ruined world in the year 2052. He appears as a result of his future counterpart (aka Berserker) regaining his sanity and his MYTH counterpart creating an accurate Tokyo in the year 2002 (according to Valkyrie). 

He reunites with his former lover Hiiro in 2016 Tokyo.
